verdict.rationale: Khoj's primary interface is natural language. Users chat about anything and search notes in natural language, and the docs extend this to voice input. Chat queries can also trigger online research, Python code execution, image generation, and scheduled automations, with slash commands as shortcuts across web, desktop, Obsidian, Emacs and WhatsApp. Missing for 10: no evidence that administration or configuration (models, agents, settings, which use an admin panel) can be done through natural language, and little independent hands-on corroboration of agentic NL operation beyond basic chat and search.
